name: Blake Bauman
title: Principal Technical Architect

hero.headline: Enterprise-scale systems, edge computing, and AI — that deliver.

summary: Principal Technical Architect with 8+ years building and shipping enterprise-scale e-commerce and cloud systems. At Adobe, I've led some of the first production implementations of next-generation Adobe products — working at the intersection of architecture, client strategy, and hands-on engineering. I know how large systems fail, how to migrate them without breaking things, and how to build organizations around them.

Outside of client work, I build. I'm developing production applications on Cloudflare's edge platform — Workers, D1, Durable Objects, Workflows — and working deeply with LLMs and AI agent architectures. I'm looking for roles where technical depth and direct impact aren't mutually exclusive: forward-deployed engineering, technical product work, or founding-stage teams where the problems are genuinely hard.

blockquote.text: I know how large systems fail, and how to fix them.

recognition.title: 2nd Place — Adobe AI Summit & Hackathon
recognition.description: We built a content generation plugin for Adobe DA.live that uses Adobe Commerce catalog data, multi-agent workflow using Langchain domain agents, and LLMs to generate AEM-ready product content. Features context-aware generation, real-time WebSocket streaming, batch page updates, and Adobe Firefly integration.

experience.description: Delivered the first production implementation of AEM Edge Delivery Services integrated with Adobe Commerce B2B Cloud for a Fortune 500 company. Led internal enablement initiatives including a webinar on Commerce with Edge Delivery that drove adoption across Adobe's enterprise customer base.

Led the migration of a global beverage company from Adobe Commerce on-prem to Adobe Commerce Cloud — zero downtime, minimal disruption. Established governance frameworks and architectural review processes across multiple enterprise implementations.

Led design and implementation of Adobe Commerce for a leading activewear company. Spearheaded Adobe Scene7 integration to optimize product imagery, improving visual merchandising and site performance.
